359:t_2:26.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Colonel...! Please head to the $$プトレマイオス２改$$ briefing room right away.」

359:t_2:28.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「We've received a transmission from $$クロノ$$'s $$クィーン$$.」

359:t_2:33.en: ～ $$プトレマイオス２改$$ Briefing Room ～

359:t_2:34.en:
$$クィーン$$
「...Have you gathered the people I specified?」

359:t_2:35.en:
$$ブライト$$
「$$桂木桂$$ and $$シャア・アズナブル$$, along with the $$スフィア・リアクター$$s, correct?」

359:t_2:36.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「We chose the rest of the attendees ourselves.」

359:t_2:38.en:
$$桂$$
(So that's the Queen-chan everyone's been talking about.)

359:t_2:39.en:
$$ランド$$
(She's got a pretty bland face, huh.)

359:t_2:40.en:
$n
(That's an avatar... In short, it's a stand-in face used to keep the real person hidden.)

359:t_2:41.en:
$$ランド$$
(Look, $n... Even a wasteland kid like me can figure that much out.)

359:t_2:42.en:
$$セツコ$$
(The $$ＵＣＷ$$ had a highly developed 《$$ＵＮ$$》, so I'm used to this kind of anonymity.)

359:t_2:43.en:
$$ランド$$
(I don't have many good memories of that, though...)

359:t_2:44.en:
$$クロウ$$
(The question is why $$クィーン$$ picked us as the ones to talk to...)

359:t_2:45.en:
$$シャア$$
($$桂$$ and I are $$特異点$$s... and you all draw out $$次元力$$...)

359:t_2:46.en:
$$シャア$$
(As I thought, $$クロノ$$'s existence must be linked to this thing called the multiverse.)

359:t_2:47.en:
$$万丈$$
「$$クィーン$$... For what purpose did you contact us?」

359:t_2:48.en:
$$クィーン$$
「I wanted to see your faces and talk with you... That is the biggest reason.」

359:t_2:49.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Would you mind telling us who you are, what you're after... and the rest?」

359:t_2:50.en:
$$クィーン$$
「It's hard to accept hearing that from a man in a mask...」

359:t_2:53.en:
$$クィーン$$
「You have shown me your resolve, $$ルルーシュ・ヴィ・ブリタニア$$.」

359:t_2:54.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「I would rather you not call me by that name.」

359:t_2:55.en:
$$クィーン$$
「Do you want to deny the self that was Emperor? Or is it your relationship with your father?」

359:t_2:56.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「I see... So you have information about us as well.」

359:t_2:57.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「No less than I'd expect from someone who claims to be a member of $$クロノ$$, which exists across parallel worlds.」

359:t_2:58.en:
$$クィーン$$
「It seems you heard that part from $$破嵐万丈$$.」

359:t_2:59.en:
$$ブライト$$
「We have been in contact with people from $$クロノ$$ several times so far.」

359:t_2:60.en:
$$クィーン$$
「The so-called Reformists, I take it.」

359:t_2:61.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Judging by how you put that, you are not one of the Reformists... In other words, you're a Conservative?」

359:t_2:62.en:
$$クィーン$$
「The answer to that is no.」

359:t_2:63.en:
$$クィーン$$
「The $$クロノ$$ Conservatives, who monitor humanity's evolution, and the $$クロノ$$ Reformists, who watch over humanity's evolution... I belong to neither.」

359:t_2:64.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Do you mean to call yourself a third $$クロノ$$?」

359:t_2:65.en:
$$クィーン$$
「I suppose so... Let's say I'm someone who couldn't care less about humanity's evolution.」

359:t_2:66.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「That's quite a free-spirited position to be in.」

359:t_2:67.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Going by the nickname '$$クィーン$$', I took you for someone of rather high standing...」

359:t_2:68.en:
$$クィーン$$
「The supreme head of each generation of $$クロノ$$ is given the name '$$キング$$'... I was the $$キング$$'s secretary, so I was given the name $$クィーン$$.」

359:t_2:69.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「Since you speak of $$クロノ$$ through the generations, I take it you were, at the very least, a member of the Conservatives.」

359:t_2:70.en:
$$クィーン$$
「I'll leave that to your imagination.」

359:t_2:71.en:
$$クィーン$$
「But at the very least, I have given you useful information.」

359:t_2:72.en:
$$万丈$$
「True, it was thanks to your information that we were able to take back this $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$.」

359:t_2:73.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「What on earth are you cooperating with us for?」

359:t_2:74.en:
$$クィーン$$
「As I said. I have no interest in something like evolution, which forms the root of $$クロノ$$'s doctrine.」

359:t_2:75.en:
$$クィーン$$
「If anything, I think it would be fine if the Conservatives and the Reformists both destroyed each other.」

359:t_2:77.en:
$$クィーン$$
「They want the present to go on. But I want the past... the peace that has passed.」

359:t_2:79.en:
$$クィーン$$
「I hate the existence of the multiverse.」

359:t_2:80.en:
$$桂$$
「I see. So that's why you called me out.」

359:t_2:81.en:
$$クィーン$$
「$$桂木桂$$... I will not forgive your existence... the original $$特異点$$ that gave birth to the multiverse.」

359:t_2:82.en:
$$クィーン$$
「But I can't stand the thought of $$サイデリアル$$ using it either.」

359:t_2:84.en:
$$クィーン$$
「The new information I'm giving you...」

359:t_2:85.en:
$$クィーン$$
「is the whereabouts of $$オルソン・Ｄ・ヴェルヌ$$.」

359:t_10:3.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「...Well, so long, $$マリーダ$$. Take care of yourself.」

359:t_10:5.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「If anything happens, come straight back.」

359:t_10:6.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「I know. The place I return to is with you, Master.」

359:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「My name is $$ＡＧ$$. In $c, I have the honor of serving as Miss $$マリーダ$$'s manager...」

359:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I am thinking of launching her as the Powered Sisters, as a set with Miss $$クェス$$ and Miss $$フォウ$$.」

359:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's what you might call a dimensional joke.」

359:t_10:13.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Master... You can ignore this thing.」

359:t_10:14.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「I'm warning you as well, $$ＡＧ$$. I will not tolerate any disrespect toward Master.」

359:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Understood. I am well aware of how much Miss $$マリーダ$$ cherishes Mr. $$ジンネマン$$.」

359:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「In the last battle, when Mr. $$ジンネマン$$ performed so splendidly, Miss $$マリーダ$$ produced $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 50 Z. I'll add them to the unit's stock.」

359:t_10:17.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「You really do work hard whenever $$Ｚチップ$$s are involved.」

359:t_10:18.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's what being a dimensional merchant is all about!」

359:t_10:21.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Nothing... Hearing you two go back and forth, I just thought you've grown used to $c too.」

359:t_10:22.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「...It's a comfortable place to be, after all.」

359:t_10:23.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Do your best, $$マリーダ$$. And don't you ever die.」

ルルーシュ・ヴィ・ブリタニア.evidence: Queen's full-name address to Lelouch (359:t_2:53); glossary has only ルルーシュ and ルルーシュ・ランペルージ; sibling names use 'vi Britannia' (Nunnally vi Britannia, Marianne vi Britannia).
